_doc: A7.1 narrative-grounding forward-only baseline — per-surface cap on the EXPECTED derived-aggregate residual (e.g. '43%'=sum of top-cause pcts). A run FAILs only if a surface EXCEEDS its cap (new fabrication). Caps lower on improvement, never auto-raise. hive_id records WHICH hive these caps were measured against: without it a reseed silently turns another hive's numbers into 'drift'.
